verdict.rationale: Windmill documents AI Agent steps that connect flows to AI providers and models, so users could build flows that run LLMs over their own data. It also documents AI generation that edits and reviews workspace items, but that is code and item assistance rather than data insights. Neither shows built-in, out-of-the-box insights or suggestions drawn from user data; this is a do-it-yourself path. Missing for 10: native AI-generated insights or suggestions over user data, any documented data-analysis or recommendation feature, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
